row.name: Reputation (Negative)
row.description: Your renown for something negative - infamy, incompetence, or notoriety - within a specific group or the galaxy at large, causing a reaction penalty. Base -5 points per -1 reaction penalty (maximum -4), then apply the same Group Size and Frequency of Recognition multipliers as the positive Reputation advantage in Chapter 4. Ranges from -5 to -20 points.
